set.body:
Outcome: amend the 2026-11-16 detail plan and the roadmap in place with a cross-cutting measurement-and-projection contract consumed by DL1-DL6 and the graph slices, as agreed with the owner in chat on 2026-11-16.
Scope: docs only (docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md, docs/ROADMAP.md) plus one implementation bead and cross-reference notes. No source, build or ADR change; new public vocabulary stays an owner ADR decision.
Acceptance: the plan states the contract, its reference, uncertainty, aggregation and temporal-projection rules and one engineering exit with named synthetic controls; the roadmap points to it; a cold review of the exact commit has no open BLOCK; branch pushed for owner review.
set.title: Plan amendment 2026-11-16: measurement-and-projection contract for the detail layer
